I am a civil engineer and a doctoral candidate at the Graduate Program in Civil
Engineering ([PPGEC](https://www.ufrgs.br/ppgec/)) of the Federal University of Rio
Grande do Sul ([UFRGS](https://www.ufrgs.br)), in Porto Alegre, Brazil, where I work
under the supervision of Prof. Samir Maghous on the micromechanics and poromechanics of
jointed rock media.

<!-- TODO: professional activity outside the university (company, role), degrees and years. -->

My work combines three things I enjoy in equal measure: deriving models from the
mechanics of the constituents, implementing them in finite element codes that others
can use, and confronting them with what is measured in the field.

## Background

- Doctoral candidate in Civil Engineering, PPGEC / UFRGS — thesis *Micromechanical
